result.option_ab_signoff: OPTION A CONFIRMED. Inline `escalation_timer_duration`/`escalation_role` attributes on :HUMAN_TASK are architecturally correct for this scope. The CHK-09/CHK-12 precedent is an exact match. Option B (:BOUNDARY_TIMER node) would require parallel-token racing semantics — cancelling one token when the other fires — a fundamentally new engine primitive with no precedent in the current codebase and no AC-driven payoff for this requirement. The 'invisible timer' drawback is real, documented in the design doc §2.2, and acceptable.
